draft_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets in the tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on five of the six datasets in the tabular suite (Fairhaven-Credit, Molton-Churn, Pemberly-Claims, Selwyn-Default, Brook-Retention), while Arbor-GBT was higher on Ivel-Fraud.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on r1, r2, r4, r5, r6 but lower on r3 (Ivel-Fraud: 92.3 vs 92.8). The claim "all six" is false; a narrower version naming the five wins and the one loss is supported.
